items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Ben Webster in the context of a band ('they were all there'), but the interviewee (Paul L. Howard) does not respond with any personal connection, memory, or confirmation of working with him. The interviewee's subsequent response discusses working with Tiny Bradshaw and doing

ctx.x: Yeah, Ben Webster, they were all there. It was a fantastic band.
